#  12906 - Network Control Technology and Dynamics 1 Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **12906 - module is no longer offered from WS 2021/22**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Network Control Technology and Dynamics 1**  |  
|  Netzleittechnik und -dynamik 1   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 3 - Mechanical Engineering, Electrical and Energy Systems   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr.-Ing. Schiffer, Johannes 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every winter semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Knowledge about Application, Tasks and Technical Equipment of Network Control Systems  |  
| Contents:  |  Fundamentals of Network Control TechnologyTerms and Definitions of the Primary Process and for Network Control Systems, View to the History, Project Management and Documentation Structure and Parts of Modern Control Systems: Sensors and Actors, Analog and Digital Signals and Informations, Programmable Controllers, Stations for Operation and Visualisation, Computeraided Design,Communication: Fieldbus, Systembus, Telecontrol Basic Tasks: Network Control, Stabilisation, Safety, Reporting and OptimizationAdvanced Tasks: Generation and Distribution Management  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Exercise / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 120 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | None  |  
| Module Examination:  | Prerequisite + Final Module Examination (MAP)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  |  Prerequisite:
  * short tests during the semenste

Final Module Examination: 
  * written examination at the end of the semester (90 minutes)

Printed and written materials like scripts or books are allowed.For calculations, non-programmable calculators are allowed.Any other type of electronic devices is NOT allowed.  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |

  * no assignment

 |
